candidate_title: Assisted Declarative Process Creation from Natural Language Descriptions

review_output.decision_rationale: Title/abstract describe assisted creation of declarative process models from natural-language descriptions, and the abstract explicitly states use of NLP techniques to identify process elements (roles, activities, constraints). It also states that DCR graphs are created directly from text documents, linking natural-language text to process-model construction. The abstract does not present the work as a survey/review; it describes implementing a tool and reporting advances.

support_spans.quote: The principal change is the inclusion of Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques to support users in the identification of roles, activities and constraints.
